Fixtures come from official OpenCV repositories: OpenCV 4.12.0 `samples/data/lena.jpg` and `samples/data/messi5.jpg`, and opencv_extra's 4.x `testdata/cv/face/100032540_1.jpg` saved as `unknown.jpg` (with its upstream readme). They are local model smoke tests, not an accuracy, demographic fairness, enrollment, liveness, or presentation-attack benchmark. Respect original image rights when redistributing test data; production packages omit these fixtures. The small Messi face is expected to fail the quality gate.
